title: Extension by zero of a Frobenius coefficient morphism
statement:
Fix the global finite-field datum and the coefficient ring
$A=A_{E,n}$. Let $j_0:X_0\hookrightarrow\bar X_0$ be a
compactification over $k_0$ of a separated finite-type $k_0$-scheme,
with base change $j:X\hookrightarrow\bar X$ to $k$, and write
$\Phi=\Phi_X$, $\bar\Phi=\Phi_{\bar X}$ for the $q$-power scheme
Frobenii of [def-trf-scheme-frobenius]. For $m\geq0$ let

$$
b_m:L\bar\Phi^{m*}j_!\xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }j_!L\Phi^{m*}
$$

be the comparison isomorphism of [lem-trf-open-square-exchange] for the
Cartesian square of [lem-trf-frobenius-open-square] with
$(h,\bar h)=(\Phi^m,\bar\Phi^m)$. Let $K\in D^b_{ctf}(X,A)$ carry an
explicit etale-origin witness [def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness].

1. *Extension of coefficient morphisms.* For every morphism
$v:L\Phi^{m*}K\to K$ put
$$
\bar v=j_!v\circ b_m:\;L\bar\Phi^{m*}j_!K\longrightarrow j_!K .
$$
If $\psi:L\Phi^*K\to K$ is a Frobenius coefficient morphism of
[def-trf-frobenius-coefficient-morphism] (no invertibility assumed),
then $\bar\psi$ is a Frobenius coefficient morphism on
$j_!K\in D^b_{ctf}(\bar X,A)$, and its iterates are the extensions of
the iterates of $\psi$:
$$
(\bar\psi)_m=\overline{\psi_m}=j_!\psi_m\circ b_m\qquad(m\geq1).
$$
1. *Stalks.* Let $\bar y$ be a geometric point of $\bar X$ with
$\bar\Phi^m\bar y=\bar y$, and let $\bar v_{\bar y}$ be the endomorphism of the pro-etale geometric stalk [def-weil-proetale-geometric-stalk] $(j_!K)_{\bar y}$ induced by $\bar v$ through
$(L\bar\Phi^{m*}j_!K)_{\bar y}\cong(j_!K)_{\bar y}$. If $\bar y$ lies in
$X$, let $v_{\bar y}$ be the endomorphism of $K_{\bar y}$ induced by $v$ through
$(L\Phi^{m*}K)_{\bar y}\cong K_{\bar y}$; then $(j_!K)_{\bar y}=K_{\bar y}$ and $\bar v_{\bar y}=v_{\bar y}$;
otherwise $(j_!K)_{\bar y}=0$.
1. *Global operators.* For the graph correspondences
$c=(\operatorname{id}_X,\Phi^m)$ and
$\bar c=(\operatorname{id}_{\bar X},\bar\Phi^m)$ of
[def-trf-graph-correspondence], the comparison
$C_{j,K}:R\Gamma_c(X,K)\xrightarrow{\sim}R\Gamma(\bar X,j_!K)$ of
[lem-trf-compactification-cohomology] intertwines the global
operators of [def-trf-global-operator]:
$$
C_{j,K}\circ T_c(v)=T_{\bar c}(\bar v)\circ C_{j,K}.
$$

proof.text:
*(1).* The complex $j_!K$ lies in $D^b_{ctf}(\bar X,A)$ by
[lem-trf-open-ctf], so $\bar\psi$ is a Frobenius coefficient morphism
on it. For the iterates, argue by induction on $m$, the case $m=1$
being the definition. The squares of [lem-trf-frobenius-open-square]
for $\bar\Phi$ and $\bar\Phi^{m-1}$ paste to the square for
$\bar\Phi^m$, so by the pasting clause of
[lem-trf-open-square-exchange], after the pullback composition
identifications,
$b_m=b_{1,L\Phi^{(m-1)*}K}\circ L\bar\Phi^*b_{m-1}$. Using the
recursion of [def-trf-frobenius-coefficient-morphism], the induction
hypothesis, and the naturality of $b_1$,

$$
(\bar\psi)_m=\bar\psi\circ L\bar\Phi^*(\bar\psi)_{m-1}
=j_!\psi\circ b_1\circ L\bar\Phi^*j_!\psi_{m-1}\circ
L\bar\Phi^*b_{m-1}
=j_!\psi\circ j_!L\Phi^*\psi_{m-1}\circ b_{1}\circ L\bar\Phi^*b_{m-1}
=j_!\psi_m\circ b_m .
$$

*(2).* Apply [lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero] to the finite ring $A$ and the open immersion $j$. It acts degreewise and gives $(j_!K)_{\bar y}=K_{\bar y}$ inside $X$ and zero outside. By [lem-exc-proetale-open-unit], restriction identifies $j^*j_!$ with the identity; this identification holds termwise on complexes, since the two functors are exact by [lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero]. The normalization in [lem-trf-open-square-exchange] identifies $j^*b_m$ with the identity. Thus restriction of $j_!v\circ b_m$ is $v$. Applying the geometric stalk functor at the fixed geometric point inside $X$ gives the same endomorphism, with the same pullback-to-stalk identification. No stalk-detection claim for arbitrary pro-etale complexes is used.

*(3).* Write $M=L\Phi^{m*}K$. The explicit witness for $K$ is a pair $(L,\alpha)$ as in [def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness]. Put $L_m=(\Phi^m_{\mathrm{et}})^{-1}L$. The comparison of [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-pullback] and pullback of $\alpha$ give the witness
$$\alpha_m:\nu_X^*L_m\xrightarrow{\sim}L\Phi^{m*}\nu_X^*L\xrightarrow{L\Phi^{m*}\alpha}M.$$
Pullback is on the stated constructible domain of [prop-functor-package], so $M$ is bounded constructible and $C_{j,M}$ is defined. For $m=0$ the maps $\Phi^m$ and $\bar\Phi^m$ are identities and are proper. For $m>0$ they are finite by induction from [def-trf-scheme-frobenius] and [lem-weil-pbc-finite-composition], hence proper by [lem-weil-pbc-finite-proper]. By [prop-trf-graph-operator],

$$
T_c(v)=R\Gamma_c(X,v)\circ\iota_X\circ R\Gamma_c(X,\eta),\qquad
T_{\bar c}(\bar v)=R\Gamma(\bar X,\bar v)\circ\iota_{\bar X}\circ
R\Gamma(\bar X,\bar\eta),
$$

where $\eta:K\to R\Phi^m_*M$ and
$\bar\eta:j_!K\to R\bar\Phi^m_*L\bar\Phi^{m*}j_!K$ are the units, and
$\iota_X$, $\iota_{\bar X}$ are the identifications
$R\Phi^m_*\simeq R\Phi^m_!$ followed by the composition law for
$a_X\Phi^m=a_X$, respectively $a_{\bar X}\bar\Phi^m=a_{\bar X}$ (the $k$-morphism and finiteness assertions are in [def-trf-scheme-frobenius]). Let
$\gamma:j_!R\Phi^m_*M\xrightarrow{\sim}R\bar\Phi^m_*j_!M$ be the
composition isomorphism of the compact-support direct image for
$j\Phi^m=\bar\Phi^mj$ ([prop-functor-package], item (3), with
$R\Phi^m_*=R\Phi^m_!$ for the finite maps $\Phi^m$, $\bar\Phi^m$). The compactification comparison and the composition isomorphism are taken in their canonical normalization of [thm-sf-comp-composition], independent of the compactification. The witness for $j_!K$ is $(j^{\mathrm{et}}_!L,\bar\alpha)$, with $\bar\alpha$ obtained by the termwise comparison of [lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero-comparison] followed by $j_!\alpha$. For $j_!M$ the witness is explicitly $(j^{\mathrm{et}}_!L_m, j_!\alpha_m\circ\delta_{j,L_m})$, where $\delta_{j,-}$ is the termwise comparison of [lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero-comparison]. Therefore all compact-support comparisons in the remaining steps are on their witnessed domain.

*Step A: the units.* Put $h=\Phi^m$, $\bar h=\bar\Phi^m$. We verify
$$\gamma\circ j_!\eta=R\bar h_*b_m\circ\bar\eta: j_!K\longrightarrow R\bar h_*j_!M.$$
The exact open adjunction of [lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero] descends termwise to complexes, and its open unit is invertible by [lem-exc-proetale-open-unit]. Hence two maps out of $j_!K$ agree if their restrictions agree under $j^*j_!K\cong K$. To identify the restricted target, use the open-restriction direct-image comparison $j^*R\bar h_*\cong Rh_*j^*$. Underived this is literally the section formula of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]: for $V\to X$, the two sides evaluate on $\bar X\times_{\bar X,\bar h}V=X\times_{X,h}V$, by the Cartesian square. It remains valid on derived functors: open restriction is a right adjoint of the exact $j_!$, so it preserves K-injectives by [lem-weil-pbc-right-adjoint-preserves-kinjective]. The ordinary units and their composition normalization are those of [fix-prop-adjunctions], clauses (1) and (3). Under the section identifications above, the adjunction bijection sends the restriction of the unit of $\bar h^*\dashv R\bar h_*$ to the unit of $h^*\dashv Rh_*$: both adjuncts are the identity map on the same pullback sections. In particular $j^*(R\bar h_*b_m\circ\bar\eta)=\eta$, since $j^*b_m$ is the identity by [lem-trf-open-square-exchange]. For the left side, restrict $\gamma$ along $j$ using the base change isomorphism $j^*R\bar h_!\simeq Rh_!j^*$ of [prop-functor-package], item (4), for the Cartesian square of [lem-trf-frobenius-open-square]; for the open $j$ this exchange map is the mate of the section identity above, so it is the same identification $j^*R\bar h_*\cong Rh_*j^*$. By the exchange and composition coherence of [fix-prop-coherence], $j^*\gamma$ becomes the composition comparison of the restricted square $\operatorname{id}_X\circ h=h\circ\operatorname{id}_X$, in which both open immersions are identities; by the identity normalization of [thm-sf-comp-composition] this is the identity comparison of $Rh_*M$. Thus $j^*(\gamma\circ j_!\eta)=\eta$ too. The open Hom bijection proves the displayed equality. This also explains the adjoint-mate interpretation in the blueprint without taking any fact from another node's proof.

*Step B: transport to cohomology.* The comparisons $C_{j,-}$ are
natural in the witnessed complex ([lem-trf-compactification-cohomology]),
so $C_{j,K}\circ R\Gamma_c(X,v)=R\Gamma(\bar X,j_!v)\circ C_{j,M}$.
They are compatible with the composition law of the compact-support
direct image ([thm-sf-comp-composition]: its canonical composition comparison is independent of all compactification choices; [fix-prop-coherence] gives the identity and composition coherence), which gives
$$
C_{j,M}\circ\iota_X\circ R\Gamma_c(X,\eta)
=\iota_{\bar X}\circ R\Gamma(\bar X,\gamma\circ j_!\eta)\circ C_{j,K}.
$$
Substituting Step A and $j_!v\circ b_m=\bar v$ (naturality of
$\iota_{\bar X}$ moves $R\bar\Phi^m_*b_m$ past it), one obtains
$C_{j,K}\circ T_c(v)=R\Gamma(\bar X,\bar v)\circ\iota_{\bar X}\circ
R\Gamma(\bar X,\bar\eta)\circ C_{j,K}=T_{\bar c}(\bar v)\circ C_{j,K}$.
No invertibility of $v$ is used anywhere.

split_report.summary: Audited and repaired the inherited five-step split against the current blueprint and the actual cited statements. Replaced the inapplicable ordinary ringed-space stalk theorem with the existing pro-etale extension theorem and open-unit theorem. Replaced the appeal to the proof of open exchange by an explicit section/restriction calculation using K-injective preservation and composite ordinary units. Replaced the inaccurate attribution of composition compatibility to refinement coherence with the actual compact-support composition theorem and proved coherence. Retained all explicit etale-origin witnesses. Added their definition and extension-by-zero to statement dependencies. No new nodes or attachments. Second reading fixes the boundary stalk typing, makes the pullback and open-extension witnesses explicit, and cites finite composition and finite-implies-proper for the graph maps.
split_report.blueprint: Realizes the current blueprint proof file at *(1)*, *(2)*, *(3)*, *Step A: the units.*, and *Step B: transport to cohomology.*

tool_uses.why: The finite-coefficient pro-etale exact open adjunction and geometric stalk formula are generic tools; the trace-formula unit has no such site theorem.
The generic pro-etale open unit is used to restrict maps out of j_!K; no trace-formula-unit node states this.
The generic etale/pro-etale inverse-image comparison transports the given witness, independently of the trace-formula argument.
The generic open-extension site comparison transports the witness to j_!K and j_!M.
Generic exact-adjoint homological algebra justifies deriving the explicit open-restriction section identity.
The ordinary composite-unit formula supplies the restriction compatibility of Frobenius units; only clauses (1) and (3) are used, with no exceptional-adjoint hypothesis.
The established identity and composition coherence normalizes the proper/open comparison and the cohomology reassociation.
Canonical compact-support composition, on bounded-below etale-origin complexes and independent of choices, supplies precisely the compatibility absent from the refinement-only statement.
Generic scheme-morphism fact establishes properness of iterated Frobenius, as required by the graph-operator formula; the trace-formula unit has no separate finite-composition theorem.
Generic finite-implies-proper fact verifies the graph-operator hypothesis for positive Frobenius iterates; used as a scheme-theoretic tool only.

The proof follows the blueprint route and no SGA source is cited. Step checks: (1) the induction directions agree with each other: b_m=b_{1}∘LΦ̄^*b_{m-1} by pasting, and the recursion in def-trf-frobenius-coefficient-morphism peels off LΦ^* the same way; b_0=id; no invertibility is used. (2) The stalk dichotomy comes from lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero (pro-étale geometric stalks), and j^*j_!≅id with j^*b_m=id gives v̄_ȳ=v_ȳ. The disputed-statement retyping is a correct typing repair: A^1⊂P^1 with ȳ=∞ has no stalk of K, and both conclusions are kept. (3) The witnesses for LΦ^{m*}K, j_!K and j_!M are explicit; Φ^m is proper via finite-composition and finite-proper; the graph-operator hypotheses hold. (4) Step A checks out: injectivity of restriction on maps out of j_!K, the section formula, K-injective preservation, the units from fix-prop-adjunctions (1) and (3), and the exchange normalization; it no longer uses another node's proof. (5) Step B rests on naturality of C_{j,-} plus choice-independence and associativity in thm-sf-comp-composition; this correctly replaces the refinement-only coherence node. Edge cases checked: m=0, m=1, j=id, the empty scheme, K=0, v=0 and the boundary point ∞. There are no new nodes and no duplicates. The tool_uses declared in the split report are accepted as generic black-box tools. Three repairs are in fixes/: (1, B3) the statement now cites def-weil-proetale-geometric-stalk for stalks, inline and in stmt_deps; (2, E4 wording) the step 3 pair (j_!^et L_m, …) is relabelled as the witness of j_!M, not M; (3, C4) step 4's claim j^*γ=id now cites open base change (prop-functor-package (4) on the square of lem-trf-frobenius-open-square), exchange and composition coherence (fix-prop-coherence) and the identity normalization of thm-sf-comp-composition; uses was extended and proof_deps is unchanged and equals the union of the uses.; 1 file(s) fixed by the reviewer
